record.title: Shipment

not_found.title: This shipment does not exist

error.title: The shipment could not be read

record.shipped: Left {when}: lines, cartons and the DDT stay as they left.
record.needsDdt: The goods left without a live DDT: issue the replacement DDT now.
record.trackingProblem: The carrier's news needs a person
record.readOnly: Read-only: your role sees shipments but does not change them.
record.noPanels: The thread, files and history are not shown here.

released.name: Released by quality

released.ok_other: {count} garments, every one released at final inspection
released.none: No garments on the shipment yet

documents.name: Declaration of Conformity and user information
documents.ok: On file for every style (PPE Reg. art. 8)

labels.name: Carrier label
labels.RECIPIENT: The customer collects: no carrier label

lines.title: Lines
lines.locked: Packed: the lines change only after Unpack (no label, no live DDT).

empty.title: No garments yet
empty.body: Add the garments quality released for this order.

cartons.title: Cartons
cartons.name: Carton {seq} of {count}

none.body: Packing happens at the pack station or here.

cartons.readyToMark: Every garment is in a weighed carton: mark it packed.

ddt.title: DDT (documento di trasporto)
ddt.notRequired: No DDT: an immediate invoice travels with the goods.
ddt.frozen: DDT {number} is issued: it never changes and its number is never used again. It is kept 10 years in the fiscal archive. A mistake is fixed by annulling it and issuing a new one.
ddt.previewFailed: The draft could not be checked
ddt.checksOpen_one: {count} check open before it can be issued
ddt.checksOpen_other: {count} checks open before it can be issued
ddt.readyToIssue: Every field is there: issuing takes number {number}.
ddt.sampleNote: Draft with the SAMPLE banner: nothing is stored, no number is used.

pdf.noFiles: Reading the PDF needs the right to read files
pdf.missing: The PDF is not stored yet: print it again
pdf.draftHeld: The draft's PDF shows once the shipment is packed and its checks pass

annulled.title: Annulled DDTs
annulled.note: An annulled DDT keeps its number and its reason; it is never deleted.

travel.title: Declaration of Conformity and user information
travel.law: PPE travel with their Declaration of Conformity and the user information (Reg. (EU) 2016/425 art. 8), in the order's language.
travel.blocked_one: {count} style cannot leave without its documents
travel.blocked_other: {count} styles cannot leave without their documents
travel.fallback_one: {count} document is in another language than the order's
travel.fallback_other: {count} documents are in another language than the order's

none.title: No PPE documents needed
none.body: No style on this shipment asks for a Declaration of Conformity.

travel.whenShipped: When the goods leave, the documents are attached and the link is mailed by themselves.
travel.allAttached: Everything on file is attached for the customer

link.title: The customer's document link
link.what: One link to the DDT, the Declaration of Conformity and the user information, for the customer's orders and quality contacts.
link.automatic: Sent by itself when the goods leave.

carrier.cutOffPassed: {time} passed: it leaves the next working day
carrier.account: Labels are bought through the company's own Sendcloud account; the carrier charges it.

noLabel.SENDER: Own van: the goods leave with the DDT, no carrier label.
noLabel.RECIPIENT: The customer collects: the goods leave with the DDT, no carrier label.

noParcels.title: No parcels yet
noParcels.body: A label is bought per parcel once the shipment is packed.

carrier.labelsHidden: Print states show to those who pack.
carrier.noPrinter: This site has no label printer: the labels print from their PDF.

tracking.title: Tracking
tracking.noEventYet: The carrier has sent no event yet.
tracking.notLeft: The goods have not left yet.

none.title: No tracking yet
none.body: Tracking starts once a label is bought.
none.RECIPIENT: The customer collects: no carrier tracking.

tracking.podLater: The carrier's signature and photo come in a later release.

issue.title: Issue DDT
issue.subtitle: Shipment {number}
issue.frozen: Number {number} is taken and kept for 10 years; the DDT cannot change after this. A mistake is fixed by annulling it and issuing a new one.
issue.frozenNoNumber: The DDT takes the next number of the company's DDT series; it cannot change after this.
issue.appearanceHint: Empty: the site's default (e.g. cardboard boxes).
issue.netHint: Optional; at most the gross {gross} kg.

ship.SENDER: The goods leave now in our van: issue and mark handed over together
ship.RECIPIENT: The customer collects now: issue and mark handed over together

reasonHint.SALE: Goods sold to the customer (the usual reason).
reasonHint.RETURN_FROM_WORK: The customer's goods going back after we worked on them.
reasonHint.ON_APPROVAL: Goods the customer may keep or send back (conto visione).
reasonHint.REPAIR: Goods travelling to or from a repair.
reasonHint.SAMPLE: Samples for the customer, not sold.
reasonHint.OTHER: Say the reason in words below; it is printed as typed.

issue.otherReasons: Processing on account and returns to a supplier travel with the DDT of their own record (Subcontracting, the supplier claim), never on a shipment to a customer.

annul.title: Annul DDT {number}
annul.what: DDT {number} will read Annulled with your reason.
annul.keeps: Its number stays with it and is never used again.
annul.packed: The shipment stays packed: issue a new DDT for the correction.
annul.shipped: The goods left: issue the replacement DDT right after.
annul.invoice: An invoiced DDT cannot be annulled: a credit note corrects the invoice.

buy.title: Buy labels
buy.outside: This leaves the building: the carrier is booked and the company's Sendcloud account is charged.
buy.void: A label is voided within the carrier's window to get the fee back.
buy.test: On a test account the labels say TEST and nothing is bought.
buy.partial: Some parcels have no label yet.

handOver.title: Mark handed over
handOver.noDdt: No DDT travels (an immediate invoice does).
handOver.documents: The documents are attached and the link is mailed to the customer.
handOver.final: The shipment's lines, cartons and DDT stay as they left.

cancel.title: Cancel shipment {number}
cancel.what: {count} garments go back to what the order can still ship.

delivery.title: Change delivery
delivery.note: Who carries it is printed on the DDT: change it before the DDT is issued.
delivery.serviceHint: Sendcloud's shipping option code: labels need one.

addLines.title: Add garments
addLines.none: Nothing more of this order is released and not on a shipment.

parcel.title: {carton}
parcel.heldWeight: A packed carton keeps a weight

link.title: Send the document link
link.what: The customer reads and downloads the DDT, the Declaration of Conformity and the user information; every download is logged.
link.resendNote: Sending again withdraws the older link of each address.
link.notSent: {email}: the mail did not go out; send again

unpack.title: Unpack
unpack.what: The shipment goes back to Draft so its cartons and lines can change.

notice.unpacked: Unpacked: the shipment is a draft again.
notice.packingList: Packing list made: the packing station prints it.
notice.ddtShipped: DDT issued and the goods marked handed over.
notice.ddtNoPdf: DDT {number} is issued; its PDF is not stored yet: print it again.
notice.ddtAnnulled: DDT annulled. Issue the new one.
notice.packingListVersion: Packing list {number} made (version {version}): the packing station prints it.
notice.packingListSame: Nothing changed since version {version}: packing list {number} is the same file.
notice.freightRule: The freight is back to the site's rule.
notice.evidenceNeeded: The shipment now needs its transport evidence.
notice.evidenceNotNeeded: The shipment needs no transport evidence.

read.forbidden: Your role does not reach this.
read.not_found: It does not exist or it is in another company.
read.unavailable: The factory is not answering: try again in a moment.
read.rate_limited: Too many requests: wait a moment.
read.internal: Something went wrong on our side.

write.moved: Someone changed this shipment meanwhile: it was read again, check and try again.
write.state: The shipment's state does not allow it now.
write.invalid: Something in what was sent is not valid.
write.signed_out: Your session ended: sign in again.
write.forbidden: Your role does not allow this.
write.rate_limited: Too many requests: wait a moment.
write.unavailable: The factory is not answering: nothing was changed.
write.internal: Something went wrong on our side: nothing was changed.
write.noService: Labels need the carrier's service: set it in Change delivery (or a default service in Carriers & shipping).
write.address: The carrier refuses the address as it stands: check the ship-to on the order.

packing.lines: at least one line of released garments
packing.empty_one: carton {parcels} filled or removed (it is empty)
packing.empty_other: cartons {parcels} filled or removed (they are empty)

void.title: Void labels
void.all_one: The carrier voids the label of the one labelled parcel of this shipment.
void.all_other: Voiding one parcel voids all {count} parcels of this shipment: the carrier cancels each label.
void.fee: The label fee comes back only within the carrier's own window: the carrier decides, not us.
void.after: The parcels can change again; buy new labels before the goods leave.
void.kept_one: The carrier has parcel {parcels} already: its label stays (ask the carrier to stop or return it).
void.kept_other: The carrier has parcels {parcels} already: their labels stay (ask the carrier to stop or return them).
void.reasonHint: A wrong weight, a wrong service, a new address… kept in the shipment's history.
void.partial: Some labels stay: see each parcel.
void.next: Buy the labels again when the parcels are right.

outcome.QUEUED: Parcel {seq}: the carrier confirms the cancellation later.
outcome.NOT_SENT: Parcel {seq}: never sent to the carrier, cleared here.

charge.title: Freight charged to the customer
charge.hidden: Shown to those who see prices
charge.hiddenNote: Freight is a price: its amount is shown to those who see prices.
charge.ruleNone: No amount: type it by hand
charge.whenLeaves: The site's rule sets it when the goods leave; type it now to charge another amount.
charge.beforeLeft: Typed by hand it stays as typed; the invoice reads it when it is issued.
charge.afterLeft: It still changes until the shipment is cancelled; the invoice reads it when it is issued.
charge.amountHint: 0 charges no freight. The order's currency.
charge.backToRule: Back to the site's rule (clear the typed amount)
charge.invoiceNote: The invoice bills it as its freight line (Finance).

basis.NO_SETTINGS: The site has no shipping settings, so no freight rule: type the freight by hand.
basis.CUSTOMER_COLLECTS: The customer collects the goods: no freight is charged.
basis.BUYER_INCOTERM: The customer's terms leave the carriage to the customer: no freight is charged.
basis.NO_PRICE: Nothing on the order carries a price (a replacement order): no freight is charged.
basis.OTHER_CURRENCY: The order is in another currency than the site's rule: type the freight by hand.
basis.RULE_NONE: The site charges no freight by default.
basis.FREE_FROM: The order reaches the site's free-freight value: the freight is free.
basis.PER_SHIPMENT: The site's rule charges one amount per shipment.
basis.PER_PARCEL_one: The site's rule charges one amount for the {parcels} parcel.
basis.PER_PARCEL_other: The site's rule charges one amount for each of the {parcels} parcels.
basis.NO_PARCELS: The site's rule charges per parcel and the shipment has no parcel yet.

invoice.title: Invoice
invoice.fromDdt: Finance invoices these goods from DDT {number} (Finance › Invoices, Shipped, not invoiced): its number, SDI state and total are on the invoice.
invoice.noDdt: No DDT yet: the invoice follows the DDT.
invoice.noDdtNeeded: Finance invoices these goods from the shipment (Finance › Invoices).
invoice.freightLine: The freight charged above is the invoice's freight line.

backorder.title: The order on this shipment
backorder.complete: This shipment completes the order: nothing stays on backorder.
backorder.completeShort_one: This shipment completes the order; {closed} garment was closed short and never ships.
backorder.completeShort_other: This shipment completes the order; {closed} garments were closed short and never ship.
backorder.partialBoth_one: {count} garment of the order stays on backorder — ready for the next shipment: {ready}; still to be made or released: {making}.
backorder.partialBoth_other: {count} garments of the order stay on backorder — ready for the next shipment: {ready}; still to be made or released: {making}.
backorder.partialReady_one: {count} garment of the order stays on backorder, released and ready for the next shipment.
backorder.partialReady_other: {count} garments of the order stay on backorder — ready for the next shipment: {ready}.
backorder.partialMaking_one: {count} garment of the order stays on backorder, still to be made or released.
backorder.partialMaking_other: {count} garments of the order stay on backorder, still to be made or released.

printDdts.what: Each live DDT goes to its site's document printer (Carriers & shipping), one print job each:
printDdts.printer: A site with no document printer is said per shipment; its DDT's PDF can be downloaded from the shipment.
printDdts.skipped_one: {numbers} has no live DDT yet: skipped.
printDdts.skipped_other: {numbers} have no live DDT yet: skipped.

why.noPrinter: its site has no document printer: set it in Carriers & shipping.
why.state: the DDT's PDF is not stored yet, or the printer takes no jobs now.
why.forbidden: your role does not print at its site.

other.title: Other documents
other.name: Packing list {number}
other.none: No packing list yet: make it from the cartons (Lines & cartons).
other.note: A packing list is made again when the cartons change; each version keeps its number. Print all opens the driver's pack in a new tab.

pack.title: Driver's pack · {number}
pack.how: Print sends this sheet and every ticked document at once, each page on its own sheet of paper. A single PDF file of the whole pack is not made: each document's own PDF is on the shipment.

held.files: The documents are still being read

pack.noAccess: Your role does not reach shipments (shipping.view).
pack.noFiles: Your role does not read files: the sheet prints alone.
pack.cancelled: The shipment is cancelled: nothing leaves with this pack.
pack.noDdt: Not issued yet: the goods do not leave without it
pack.parcelsLabel: The parcels with their tracking numbers

missing.ddtPdf: Its PDF is not stored yet: print it again from the shipment.
missing.packingList: No packing list yet: make it from the cartons.
missing.travel: Not on file: the goods cannot leave without it.
missing.noFiles: Prints with the right to read files.

pack.fileFailed: It could not be read: open the shipment and download it.
pack.drawFailed: This PDF could not be drawn: print it from the shipment.

evidence.title: Intra-EU transport evidence

need.sale: A zero-rated sale to another EU state ({country}): keep the proof that the goods arrived there (art. 41 DL 331/1993).
need.byOffice: The office said this shipment needs the proof that the goods arrived in {country}.
need.none: Not needed: not a zero-rated sale to another EU state.
need.whenLeaves: A zero-rated sale to {country}: the proof is awaited once the goods leave.
need.later: Decided when the goods leave: only a zero-rated sale to another EU state needs it.

what.needed: The shipment is then awaited until its papers are on file and a person marks them complete.
what.notNeeded: The shipment no longer waits for transport papers. Use it only when the sale is not zero-rated to another EU state.

hint.needed: E.g. the order was zero-rated after it left; kept in the shipment's history.
hint.notNeeded: E.g. the goods stayed in Italy; kept in the shipment's history.

missing.none: Nothing on file yet: two papers from parties independent of each other, one of them a transport document.
missing.transport_one: {count} paper on file, not a transport document: add a signed CMR, the carrier's invoice or its proof of delivery.
missing.transport_other: {count} papers on file, none a transport document: add a signed CMR, the carrier's invoice or its proof of delivery.
missing.second_one: {count} paper on file: a second one from another independent party is needed.
missing.second_other: {count} papers on file: a second one from another independent party is needed.
missing.check: The papers on file may be enough: a person checks them and marks the evidence complete.

kindHint.CMR: The consignment note signed by the recipient at delivery.
kindHint.CARRIER_INVOICE: The carrier's invoice for this transport.
kindHint.POD: The carrier's proof of delivery (signature, time, place).
kindHint.OTHER: An insurance, bank or authority paper about this transport.

none.title: No paper on file
none.body: File the carrier's proof of delivery, the signed CMR or the carrier's invoice.

evidence.law: Art. 45a Reg. (EU) 282/2011: two non-contradictory papers from parties independent of each other, of us and of the buyer — two transport documents (a signed CMR, the carrier's invoice, its proof of delivery), or one with an insurance, bank or authority paper. Kept 10 years.

file.title: File a transport paper
file.hint: PDF or a photo (JPEG, PNG), up to 25 MB.
file.type: Not a PDF or a photo.

complete.title: Mark the evidence complete
complete.check: Check that the papers come from parties independent of each other, of us and of the buyer, and do not contradict each other.

reopen.title: Reopen the evidence
reopen.what: A paper was found wrong: the evidence goes back to partial (or awaited without papers).

what.eu: Inside the EU no customs papers are needed; a zero-rated sale keeps its transport evidence (above).
what.outside: Goods leaving the EU need export papers and the proof of exit (art. 8 DPR 633/72).
